name: critic-P05/P23 round 2 — the three findings, reproducible: the ghost, the doorway, the ten doors

steps.note: 0 — the child's own route in: no teleports, walk the lane out of the vale.
1 — P05#2: stand on each door's OWN step-back spot (walkable ground a child reaches) and orbit the camera behind the building. Read every alpha.

steps.eval: JSON.stringify(await (async()=>{const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const m=await import('/src/world/maps/puddlewick.js');const L=m.default;const S=L.spots.doors;const out=[];for(const ex of L.exits){if(ex.kind!=='door')continue;const s=S[ex.to];if(!s)continue;const camAng=Math.atan2(ex.x-s.x,ex.z-s.z)*180/Math.PI;__DQ.teleport('puddlewick',s.x,s.z);await w(600);__DQ.cameraOrbit((camAng+360)%360,true);await w(1500);const f=__DQ.cameraOccluders();out.push({at:ex.to,stand:[+s.x.toFixed(2),+s.z.toFixed(2)],ground:__DQ.state().player.ground,fading:f.map(o=>({n:o.name,a:+o.alpha.toFixed(3),inside:o.inside,melted:o.melted}))});}return out;})())

JSON.stringify(await (async()=>{const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const m=await import('/src/world/maps/puddlewick.js');const L=m.default;const S=L.spots.doors;const ex=L.exits.find(e=>e.to==='puddlewick_shop');const s=S.puddlewick_shop;const camAng=Math.atan2(ex.x-s.x,ex.z-s.z)*180/Math.PI;__DQ.teleport('puddlewick',s.x,s.z);await w(700);__DQ.cameraOrbit((camAng+360)%360,true);await w(1600);return __DQ.cameraOccluders();})())

steps.note: 1b — it also happens while simply walking the lane past the inn.
2 — P05#4: the chapel doorway, straight on and oblique, with a grass census through the opening.

steps.eval: JSON.stringify((()=>{const c=document.querySelector('canvas');const g=document.createElement('canvas');g.width=c.width;g.height=c.height;const x=g.getContext('2d');x.drawImage(c,0,0);const d=x.getImageData(0,0,g.width,g.height).data;let grass=0,tot=0;const x0=Math.round(g.width*0.40),x1=Math.round(g.width*0.60),y0=Math.round(g.height*0.10),y1=Math.round(g.height*0.62);for(let y=y0;y<y1;y++)for(let xx=x0;xx<x1;xx++){const i=(y*g.width+xx)*4;tot++;const r=d[i],gg=d[i+1],b=d[i+2];if(gg>r+18&&gg>b+25)grass++;}return {tot,grass,pct:+(100*grass/tot).toFixed(2)};})())

steps.note: 3 — P23#6: walk into all ten doors on foot, ArrowUp aimed at each door (orbit = worldAngle + 180).

steps.eval: JSON.stringify(await (async()=>{const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const m=await import('/src/world/maps/puddlewick.js');const L=m.default;const S=L.spots.doors;const out=[];for(const ex of L.exits){if(ex.kind!=='door')continue;const s=S[ex.to];if(!s)continue;const want=Math.atan2(ex.x-s.x,ex.z-s.z)*180/Math.PI;__DQ.teleport('puddlewick',s.x,s.z);await w(600);__DQ.cameraOrbit((want+180+360)%360);await w(900);const p0=[__DQ.state().player.x,__DQ.state().player.z];__DQ.hold('up',1400);await w(2100);const st=__DQ.state();out.push({door:ex.to,now:st.map.id,moved:+Math.hypot(st.player.x-p0[0],st.player.z-p0[1]).toFixed(2),dlg:st.dialogue&&st.dialogue.open?String(st.dialogue.full||st.dialogue.text).replace(/\n/g,' ').slice(0,130):null});if(st.map.id!=='puddlewick'){__DQ.teleport('puddlewick',s.x,s.z);await w(800);}else{__DQ.press('cancel',80);await w(400);}}return out;})())

steps.note: 4 — P23#7: search every searchable thing in the village and count the takings.

steps.eval: JSON.stringify(await (async()=>{const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const m=await import('/src/world/maps/puddlewick.js');const L=m.default;const out=[];const g0=__DQ.state().gold;for(const c of (L.chests||[])){__DQ.teleport('puddlewick',c.x+0.9,c.z+0.9);await w(800);__DQ.press('confirm',90);await w(1400);const st=__DQ.state();out.push({id:c.id,kind:c.kind,item:c.item||null,said:st.dialogue&&st.dialogue.open?String(st.dialogue.full||st.dialogue.text).replace(/\n/g,' ').slice(0,110):null});__DQ.press('cancel',80);await w(500);}return {goldStart:g0,goldEnd:__DQ.state().gold,n:out.length,results:out};})())
